# S4.14a — extension supply-chain trust (C1) + third-party install

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s4.13` (PR #76) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the extension supply-chain trust surface at C1 plus the
third-party publish/install path: `TrustRootPolicy` gates (source
allowlists, required attestation predicates, signature-required
quarantine, `StalePin` on policy/signer supersession), surface pins
with `DriftPolicy{notify, pause_surface, terminate}` emitting
`security.extension.drift`, advisory `review`/`approve_seal_diff`,
update/supersession with named `LabelRegression`s (a dropped
`trust.surface_pin` is `{field: "trust.surface_pin", now:
"unpinned"}`), and revocation propagation (surfaces dropped, grants
→ deny, in-flight effects → `unknown`, `depends_on_revoked`)
(`R-2.8.5` C1). Lands the `ApproverGrant` lifecycle — ledgered
`security.permission.grant_{issued,revoked}` rows, `grant_approver`
legitimacy (principal bootstrap or covered delegate, never-widen),
respond-path gate — plus the calibrated `auto_review` binding
(`ReviewerBinding`, typed per-clause refusals, failure → deny above
`reversible`, `security.permission.reviewed`) and the six approval
metric declarations (`approval_rate`, `denial_rate`,
`approvals_per_kilo_effect`, `median_decision_latency_ms`,
`lease_hit_ratio`, `auto_review_fn_rate`) with hosted `n/a{class}`
(`R-2.8.7` C1). Lands the third-party legs: foreign plugin
import/export (`claude plugin.json`, `gemini-extension.json`,
`codex agent-plugin`) quarantined with named `LossReport`s, the
ACP `session/request_permission` round-trip preserving
`permission_id`/`effect_id`/`effective_risk_class`/`reason_code`
under `params._hh` with `hh-edge-loss/1` losses for
`modify`/`escalate`/`abort_run`/`max_uses`/`deadline`, and
`container`/`remote` placements on the variant host (`R-2.12.2¹`).

Requirement ids: `R-2.8.5`, `R-2.8.7`, `R-2.12.2¹`.
Gates: `AC-R-2.8.5-{4,6,7,8,9}`, `AC-R-2.8.7-{8,10,12,13}`,
`removability(0…3)` — all deterministic.

## What changed

- **`crates/hh-registry`** —
  - `extension/lifecycle.rs` (new): the TrustView policy union —
    source allowlists at `discover`/`resolve`, required-predicate
    attestation coverage (`AttestationFailed` names the uncovered
    predicate), `require_signature_for` → `Admission::Quarantined`,
    `max_attestation_age`/policy-supersession → `StalePin`; `pin`
    (definition lift under `security.label.endorsed{basis: pin}`);
    `review()` advisory plan (extension id, install plan, requested
    env keys, surface delta, attestation status, text hygiene);
    `update_assessment` (widening on new contribution paths +
    named `LabelRegression`s; `approve_seal_diff` over the
    `HirDiff`); `model_install` procedure
    (`install_requested`/`install_completed`, attenuated+tainted
    result, `AuthorityWidening`); `propagate_revocation` (server
    terminations, dropped surfaces, grants → deny, in-flight →
    `unknown`, `depends_on_revoked`); `check_surface` + the three
    drift policies with changed-tool suppression.
  - `extension/foreign_plugin.rs` (new): the `ForeignPluginFormat`
    closed sum; imports land quarantined with named losses;
    Gemini `trust` members are claims, never grants;
    export/re-import round trip.
- **`crates/hh-monitor`** (`approval.rs`) — `ApproverGrant` +
  `grant_approver`/`revoke_approver` (`IllegitimateGrant` typed);
  `ApprovalState.grants` folded from `grant_issued`/`grant_revoked`;
  respond path accepts `EndorserRef::ApproverGrant` only under a
  live covering grant (`covers` checks expiry/revocation/risk
  ceiling/prefix); `ReviewerBinding` + `check_auto_review_binding`
  (`Uncalibrated`/`PermissionWidening`/`EgressAdmitted`/
  `EvidenceBelowFloor`), `auto_review_failure_denies`,
  `reviewed_payload`.
- **`crates/hh-ledger`** — `security.permission.grant_{issued,
  revoked}` + `security.permission.reviewed` class rows and
  hosted-lowering pairs; `WakeupPolicy::from_json` member-default
  fix (missing members default — the pre-existing strict decode
  broke `subscribe{policy:{delivery_mode}}` at base).
- **`crates/hh-acp`** — `permission.rs`: `PRESERVED_REQUEST_MEMBERS`
  under `params._hh`, `permission_losses`/`permission_loss_report`
  (`hh-edge-loss/1`), `inbound_losses` on `PermissionRequest`;
  `serve.rs` attaches `_hh` on the lowered request; the outcome
  lift stays deny-by-default.
- **`crates/hh-eval`** — the six approval `MetricDeclaration`s
  (`permission_surface`-gated → hosted `n/a{class}`;
  `median_decision_latency_ms` uses bootstrap — `ms` is
  heavy-tailed, CLT forbidden per ADR-0158; `auto_review_fn_rate`
  declares `judge` oracle).
- **`crates/hh-lab`** — `lab/extension-trust-v1`
  (`trust{external,sealed} × isolation{confined,unconfined}`,
  `MatchSpec ∋ approvals.requested`, Π-denial primaries) and
  `lab/approval-mode-v1` (`approval_mode × reviewer × budget`,
  `MatchSpec ∋ approvals.requested`, calibration-debt
  conditioning, unmatched refusal).
- **`crates/hh-varhost`** — `SpawnSpec.placement` +
  `helper_extra_args`; `container` forces the helper `container`
  (podman) lane; `remote` never spawns — `attach` over a caller
  transport; first-party-only placements refuse typed
  (`PlacementRefused`); `isolation()` reports the real lane.
- **`crates/hh-identity`** — `supersede.rs`: stale-by-dependency
  and `depends_on_revoked` propagation.
- **`crates/hh-embed` + schema** — `extension_ops.rs` (new):
  `lab.extension.{discover,resolve,review,check_surface,update,
  revoke,install,import_plugin,export_plugin}` +
  `lab.permission.{grant,revoke}_approver`; op registry entries;
  regenerated `hh-embed-1.schema.json` + generated client; the
  respond path's `RespondCtx.grants` now folds from the ledger.
- **Tests** — `hh-registry/tests/s4_14a.rs` (16), `hh-monitor/
  tests/s4_14a.rs` (9), `hh-acp/tests/s4_14a.rs` (4).
